stem:
Vihaan keeps a Class 7 diary. He notices stronger moods than last year and sometimes snaps at friends, then feels sorry.

Which claim about adolescence is correct?

options.text: Adolescence includes emotional and behavioural changes as well as physical ones, and recognising emotions can help him choose thoughtful actions.
Stronger emotions by themselves help him make more thoughtful choices.
His stronger moods are only the result of how he acts, not a cause of changes in behaviour.
Adolescence involves only physical changes, such as height, hair, and voice changes.

teacher.key_rationale: Adolescence includes emotional and behavioural changes, not only physical ones. Recognising emotions can guide thoughtful actions; stronger emotions alone do not, and emotions can influence behaviour rather than only result from it.
